profile.text:
Patrizion is a citizen of Laterano entitled to the rights listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution, and the longest-tenured active gun-knight of Laterano. He is intimately familiar with the use of various types of firearms.
In accordance with the memorandum of cooperation between the Lateran Curia and Rhodes Island, he is currently stationed on Rhodes Island as a collaborating operator under the code name Sankta Miksaparato.
